hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^git\s+commit"; then STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.rs$"); if [ -n "$STAGED" ]; then FMT=$(cargo fmt --check 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: cargo fmt check failed — unformatted Rust code:" >&2; echo "$FMT" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; fi; CLIPPY=$(cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: clippy warnings found:" >&2; echo "$CLIPPY" | head -30 >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi; exit 0'

Fix the code instead." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^git\s+commit"; then MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oP "(?<=-m\s)([\x27\"])(.*?)\1" | head -1 | tr -d "\x27\""); if [ -n "$MSG" ]; then if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE "^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\(.+\))?!?:\s.+"; then echo "BLOCKED: Commit message must follow Conventional Commits format." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.rs$"; then if grep -nE "^\s*(println!\(|dbg!\(|eprintln!\()" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "(//|/\*)" | head -5; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"additionalContext\":\"⚠️ Debug macro detected in $FILE (println!/dbg!/eprintln!) — remove before commit\"}}"; fi; fi; exit 0'

PostToolUse.description: Warn about println!, dbg!, eprintln! debug macros after edits

hooks.command: bash -c 'EDITED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.rs$"); if [ -n "$EDITED" ]; then cargo fmt 2>/dev/null; CLIPPY=$(cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"additionalContext\":\"❌ Clippy warnings:\n$(echo "$CLIPPY" | grep -E "^(error|warning)" | head -15)\"}}"; fi; fi; exit 0'

Stop.description: Batch format (cargo fmt) and lint (clippy) all edited Rust files at response end
